question: Should OpenClaw add a public internal `session:end` hook event, or should workflow integrations use the existing typed plugin `session_end` lifecycle hook instead?
rationale: Both surfaces can support completion automation, but adding an internal hook expands the public automation API while the plugin hook already exists as the typed runtime lifecycle contract.

options.title: Use plugin session_end as contract
options.body: Document typed plugin `session_end` as the supported completion surface for workflow integrations and close or retitle this issue after that decision is visible.

options.title: Approve internal session:end
options.body: Define and document a narrow internal `session:end` event, then implement it consistently across the relevant session completion paths with focused tests.

options.title: Wait for linked PR outcome
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/61675 is landed or closed, then reassess any remaining internal-hook gap.

recommendation.title: Use plugin session_end as contract
recommendation.body: Document typed plugin `session_end` as the supported completion surface for workflow integrations and close or retitle this issue after that decision is visible.
